name: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 reference design
description: Reference/Founders Edition specification snapshot. Precision list is a researched subset, not exhaustive; partner boards and runtime allocation require separate evidence.

provenance.notes: Full specifications: 24GB GDDR6X, PCI Express Gen 4, CUDA capability 8.9, 450W total graphics power. Reference/Founders Edition scope; not measured training draw, whole-system power or current price. Product documentation supports snapshot active only; stock and billing remain unknown.

Ada Tuning Guide 13.4, section 1.4.1.3 documents FP32 operations for compute capability 8.9. Together with RTX 4090 capability 8.9 this supports the submitted non-exhaustive fp32 subset; no exclusion of other precisions and no joint engine/model support inferred.
